subject: modifying STAR and SETAR to include Exogenous variables

messages.author: e9811284c718c9ae
messages.subject: modifying STAR and SETAR to include Exogenous variables
parts:
Hi

I would like to modify the STAR and SETAR codes to allow for the inclusion of exogenous variables. I'm not well versed in R, but past posts imply this should be a straight forward task.

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!searchin/tsdyn/exogenous/tsdyn/g4bvguZ_fTQ/Vd5NnH0mOAoJ

" you should seek to replace simply the xxL, xxH (line 85-86) and th by your own regressors. Adapting the code from there should require little changes, do not look at lines after 246, since these are specific to tsDyn. "



But then I find somewhat conflicting comments from another post which makes the task seem rather arduous.

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!searchin/tsdyn/exogenous/tsdyn/ts-FZgL6D8E/g8V7RKAnYKEJ


"If you were to modify lstar() yourself, you should modify several lines, the most important being 85 and 86:
xxL <- cbind(const,xx[,1:mL])

then add your regressors. YOu will need probably to modify the code at several other places, to take into account the fact that you have more regressors, hence parameter naming might fail. You will in any case not be able to use the predict() since the predict use a loop starting from zero to re-create the series. This would require significant changes.

Good luck"


Has anybody had any luck with this? Matthieu are you still the keeper of tsDyn? Can anybody provide me with some guidance?
